name: Cyanobacteria (blue-green algae)
description: Photosynthetic bacteria of the open water. Functional group pooling the four cyanobacteria taxa in the source web - Nostoc sp., Chroococcus dispersus, Dactylococcopsis fascicularis and the bloom-forming Microcystis aeruginosa - following the major phytoplankton classes used by the limnological literature.
